quote: With a Democratic Congress, we will pass national legislation to make Roe the law of the land again.

sourceTitle.en: 2024 Democratic Party Platform (PDF, undated; text published by the DNC in its press release of August 18, 2024, for a delegate vote the next day), p. 51

summary.en: The platform says that with a Democratic Congress, Democrats will pass national legislation to make Roe the law of the land again.
